loeschkonzept.loeschkonzept-aufbewahren-: Deletion concept: retaining, locking and deleting with Ablago

loeschkonzept.kein-mappentyp-betrifft-ei: No folder type concerns a person – set under “Personal data in folder types” which folder types concern people.
loeschkonzept.nur-die-jeweils-letzte: only the latest one in each case
loeschkonzept.name-anschrift-wie-unter: Name, address – as under Workbench → Own organisation

loeschkonzept.welche-daten-z-b: Which data: e.g. tenants and tenancies, customers, suppliers, employees …
loeschkonzept.jeder-mappentyp-in-ablago: Every folder type in Ablago is a data type. The table contains the folder types that concern a person, link to one or have a purpose entered (as of {datum}). Purpose and “concerns a person” are under Workbench → Deletion concept → Personal data in folder types, period and reference date in archive mode under Workbench → Folder types.
loeschkonzept.ohne-personenbezug-nicht-i: Without personal reference (not in the table): {ohne}. If one of them does concern people, mark it under Workbench → Deletion concept → Personal data in folder types and create the deletion concept again.
loeschkonzept.archivmodus-werkbank-mappe: Archive mode (Workbench → Folder types → Archive mode): folders and documents of this folder type can’t be deleted until the end of the retention period – not even by administrators, via the bin or the interface for programs. Documents only change as a new version. The period runs until 31 December of the reference year plus the years.
loeschkonzept.keine-die-mappen-lassen: None: the folders can be deleted at any time. Who may do so is set by the permissions (section 5).
loeschkonzept.aufbewahrung-abgelaufen-na: Retention expired: after the end of the period the folders appear under Workbench → Users and security → Retention expired. Ablago never deletes by itself.
loeschkonzept.ansicht-fuer-fristen-ohne: View: for periods without archive mode, the view {FEHLT} shows the folders due by the field {FEHLT2}.
loeschkonzept.ablago-haelt-jede-loeschun: Ablago records every deletion in the deletion log (section 8).
loeschkonzept.geht-werkbank-aufbewahrung: {FEHLT} goes through Workbench → Retention expired and the views from section 2 {FEHLT2} and deletes what may go.{wert}
loeschkonzept.geloeschte-mappen-und-doku: Deleted folders and documents go to the bin (Workbench → Bin, retention {tage}). After that Ablago permanently deletes them with their files and the full text.
loeschkonzept.der-papierkorb-ist-ausgesc: The bin is switched off: Ablago permanently deletes deleted folders and documents immediately with their files and the full text.
loeschkonzept.die-historie-endgueltig-ge: The history of permanently deleted folders stays for {tage} (Workbench → Bin) so that it can be traced what happened to them. The history of living folders and of folders in archive mode always stays – with all kinds of entries, including retrievals (download, interface, drive); no kind is deleted earlier. Entries “in administration mode” stay even after this period.
loeschkonzept.verlangt-eine-person-die: If a person requests deletion but a retention period stands in the way (Art. 17(3) GDPR), their data is locked until the end of the period (Art. 18 GDPR):
loeschkonzept.mappen-im-archivmodus-sind: Folders in archive mode are locked against deletion (section 2).
loeschkonzept.zugriff-der-mappentyp-hat: Access: the folder type has the yes/no field {FEHLT}. A rule in the permissions allows reading and editing with “Locked is yes” only for the role {FEHLT2}. Administrators still see everything.
loeschkonzept.an-der-mappe-steht: There is a note on the folder with the date of the request and the end of the lock.
loeschkonzept.nach-fristende-wird-geloes: After the end of the period, deletion follows section 3.
loeschkonzept.z-b-nur-die: e.g. only the role … / everyone who may edit the folder
loeschkonzept.loeschen-duerfen-werkbank: {FEHLT} may delete (Workbench → Folder types → Permissions, permission “Delete”).
loeschkonzept.endgueltig-loeschen-und-de: Delete permanently and empty the bin: every user for what they deleted themselves; administrators for everything (Workbench → Bin).
loeschkonzept.administratoren-fuer-sie-g: Administrators: {FEHLT}. Permissions don’t apply to them.
loeschkonzept.geloeschte-daten-koennen-n: Deleted data may still be in these places; it disappears like this:
loeschkonzept.ablago-entfernt-aeltere-si: Ablago removes older backups after each automatic backup
loeschkonzept.vollexporte-und-persoenlic: Full exports and personal exports (export folder, not part of the backup)
loeschkonzept.ablago-loescht-sie-nach: Ablago deletes them after downloading, at the latest when the period ends
loeschkonzept.hoechstens-mit-abruf-link: at most {replace}, with a download link until it expires
loeschkonzept.24-stunden-in-der: 24 hours in the Workbench; container logs {FEHLT}
loeschkonzept.ggf-log-rotation-einstelle: set up log rotation if needed
loeschkonzept.konten-die-schon-benutzt: Accounts that have already been used are deactivated, not deleted (Workbench → Users → Lock access). The name stays under “created by” and in the history.
loeschkonzept.einladungen-die-nie-angeno: Invitations that were never accepted are deleted.
loeschkonzept.deaktiviert-konten-von-per: {FEHLT} deactivates the accounts of people who leave, {FEHLT2}.
loeschkonzept.ablago-fuehrt-ein-loeschpr: Ablago keeps a deletion log (Workbench → Deletion concept → Deletion log): for each deleted folder the folder type, ID and number, when, by whom, why and in which operation; for each deleted document the checksum (SHA-256), size, file type and page count – without title, field values and file names. It can’t be changed, is output as PDF or CSV and is automatically shortened after one year.

loeschkonzept.bei-loeschungen-auf-verlan: For deletions on request, whoever deletes chooses the reason “At the request of the data subject”.
loeschkonzept.auskuenfte-nach-art-15: Access requests under Art. 15 GDPR are recorded with evidence in the person’s history (Workbench → Data protection requests).

loeschkonzept.erzeugt-aus-den-mappentype: Created from the folder types and settings of your Ablago. Replace everything in [square brackets] with your details or delete it.
